environment.description: Same Django application deployed on EKS with Istio service mesh. Token lifecycle managed by HashiCorp Vault dynamic secrets engine with a TTL of 60 seconds and max_ttl of 60 seconds on the database/creds/notes-api role. The DRF TokenAuthentication is replaced at runtime by a custom VaultTokenAuthentication middleware that validates tokens against Vault's token lookup endpoint on every request - tokens are rotated by a sidecar every 60s and previous token leases are explicitly revoked. The frontend CSP is enforced by an Envoy filter in the Istio sidecar with: default-src 'self'; script-src 'nonce-{random}'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:. Additionally, the Envoy WASM filter applies response body transformation that runs DOMPurify-equivalent sanitization on all JSON response fields matching the pattern 'content' before transmission to clients. The bleach library version is the same (5.0.1) but the Envoy response filter strips javascript: protocol URIs from href attributes in response payloads regardless of what's stored in the database.

config.response_sanitization: Envoy WASM filter (proxy-wasm/DOMPurify-rs) on content fields
config.envoy_filter_config: strips javascript: and data: from href/src attributes in JSON responses
config.credential_stolen_impact: token expires within 60s max, revoked on next rotation cycle
